components.name: Project caption
components.description: Persistent collection identity: actual collection index, project name and category, separated by a structural baseline.

narrative.overview: An experimental editorial identity with cinematic scale: light condensed lettering counterbalances tall photographic apertures and deliberate gaps. Warm photographs sit directly on charcoal; unequal compositions provide variety. The original transparent silver/gold logo and all 38 supplied photographs remain the evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized condensed type and real architectural photography.
Charcoal grounds, warm ivory text and precise brass marks.
Unequal grids, square frames and open corners.
Manual interactions, native disclosures and progressive enhancement.

rules.name: The Photograph Rule
rules.body: Preserve supplied photographs without a permanent color wash, saturation filter or replacement imagery.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow for expressive scale and Instrument for reading and controls. Reserve monospace for indices and perspective numbers.

dos: **Do** preserve the original logo and all 38 photographs; consult `project-assets.json` and `.impeccable/asset-provenance.json` for mappings, hashes and origins.
**Do** maintain the distinct display/body/index roles, unequal compositions, square frames and complete frames in galleries.
**Do** retain factual names: Residence, Restaurant 1, Entrance, Restaurant 2 and Ice cream parlour.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, native disclosures, reduced-motion behavior and usable static content.
**Do** use the confirmed phone and Instagram for direct conversation.
donts: **Don't** introduce stock/generated replacement photography, permanent image filters, identical project cards, luxury serif styling, ornamental gradients or rounded panels.
**Don't** restore loaders, custom cursors, liquid effects, autoplay or runtime animation libraries.
**Don't** invent clients, dates, credentials, drawings, measurements or statistics.
**Don't** publish addresses, office locations, maps, directions or physical-visit invitations; the studio works remotely.
**Don't** imply that a locally downloaded brief has been sent.
